blurb: The Albeni Cove Recreation Area is located directly across the Pend Oreille River from the Albeni Falls Dam. From Highway 2, turn south onto Highway 41 at Newport, WA. Follow for 1/2 mile and turn east on Fourth Street into Oldtown, ID. Follow a paved then gravel road for approximately three miles.
hoursText: Seven Days a Week, 7:30 am - 4:00 pm
